sponsor_or_proposer: Government of Ukraine / Naftogaz; previously floated with Excelerate Energy + Gas Natural (Naturgy); 2025-10 Zelenskyy pitch to US energy companies (unnamed)
current_state: Recurring political/rhetorical revival of the cancelled Odesa LNG / Black Sea LNG terminal at Pivdennyi (Yuzhnyi) Port. Already in GEM as cancelled terminal T100000130561 'Ukraine LNG Terminal'. No firm new sponsor commitment, no FID, no construction; project explicitly contingent on Turkey/Bosphorus Strait transit negotiations that remain unresolved as of Oct 2025.
missing_threshold_elements: Concrete step (no MOU/FEED/permit/site-works tied to a current sponsor; the only 'agreements' cited trace to the cancelled 2012-2013 national project); committed sponsor (Gas Natural denied involvement; 2025 pitch names no specific firm). Location and rough scope are known.
watch_for: A firm new FSRU charter or onshore FEED award with a named current sponsor (e.g. Excelerate, a European utility); resolution of Bosphorus transit terms with Turkey; a Ukrainian govt tender/consortium decision. If any lands, this is a status/timeline update to T100000130561 (dead-and-revived), NOT a new terminal.
notes: Verified non-discovery: same site/project as existing cancelled GEM row (aliases Odessa LNG, Black Sea LNG, Pivdennyi=Yuzhnyi Port). Tracked here so future sweeps don't re-discover it. Ukraine's actual 2025-2026 LNG supply runs through neighbours' terminals (Klaipeda, Swinoujscie, German, Greek) via interconnectors, plus small-scale truck-LNG and bio-LNG (YM Liquid Gas) — all below GEM terminal scope, no Ukrainian marine import/export terminal under construction.
